deliverable.title: Current Note Markdown Export Action Brief
deliverable.objective: Add an export button to the fictional notes app that downloads the currently selected note as Markdown, with explicit handling for ready, no-note-selected, and export-failure states. Exclude cloud sync and PDF export.
decisions: Export only the current note as Markdown.
Support three required states: ready, no note selected, and export failure.
Use the note title for the downloaded filename.
Preserve headings and lists in the exported Markdown.

actions.task: Implement the Markdown export control and download behavior.
actions.next_step: Add an export button that serializes the selected note to Markdown and initiates a local file download named from the note title.
actions.acceptance_condition: With a note selected, activating export downloads a Markdown file whose filename uses the note title and whose content preserves headings and lists.

actions.next_step: Define and implement the export button behavior when no note is selected.
actions.acceptance_condition: When no note is selected, the interface presents a clear non-exportable state and does not download a file.

actions.next_step: Catch export or download failures and expose a visible failure state.
actions.acceptance_condition: When export fails, no false success is shown and the user receives a clear failure indication.

actions.next_step: Test successful export, no-note-selected behavior, export failure, filename generation, Markdown preservation, and excluded features.
actions.acceptance_condition: All checklist items pass, and neither cloud sync nor PDF export is introduced.

acceptance_checklist: A selected note can be exported as a downloaded Markdown file.
The downloaded filename uses the note title.
The ready state permits export of the current note.
The no-note-selected state prevents download and is clearly represented.
An export failure produces a clear failure indication without reporting success.
risks: Filename behavior is underspecified for empty titles or characters invalid in filenames.
The expected UI treatment for the no-note-selected and export-failure states is unspecified.
The source note data model and its Markdown serialization rules are unspecified.
Browser or runtime download constraints may affect implementation behavior.

assumptions: “Uses the note title” means the title forms the downloaded filename with a Markdown file extension.
“Preserves headings and lists” means those structures remain valid Markdown structures after export.
Implementation and test owners remain unassigned because no people or roles were supplied.
missing_inputs: Implementation owner and test owner assignments.
Expected behavior for untitled notes and filename-invalid characters.
Required UI copy and visual treatment for no-note-selected and export-failure states.
The fictional app’s technology stack, note data model, and existing export interfaces.
A defined way to trigger or simulate export failure during testing.
